name: 25419 · Falling Wtrs, WV
findings: ZIP 25419 (Falling Wtrs) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25419 (Falling Wtrs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
